TC Electronic M3000 read through a search summary 2026-11-12 (the zzounds page answered 403) of the Sound On Sound review and the manufacturer specification pages: a pair of balanced XLR analog inputs and outputs, XLR AES/EBU in and out, RCA S/PDIF in and out, optical (TOSLINK, ADAT or S/PDIF) in and out, a phono word clock input, MIDI in, out and thru (no catalogue signal, not ports). The mains connection is not stated, so no mains inlet is modelled. 483 x 208 x 44 mm (dealer, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
